end.summary:
Kavya named Diwali features including lights, fireworks, and sweets.
They practised noticing that festivals can differ by region and mentioned Bengal’s Kali Puja; this was partly right, not steady yet.
They practised linking harvest festivals with the season crops are ready; the connection is still to check next time.
Kavya said festival timing could be random and repeated that harvest festivals may happen at any time; this mix-up was not corrected by the last turn.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised how festivals can be celebrated differently in different regions and linked harvest festivals with farming seasons. They gave examples such as Diwali lights, fireworks, sweets, and Bengal’s Kali Puja; the regional connection was partly right but not steady yet. The idea that harvest festivals happen when crops are ready was still mixed up at the end. At home, look at a calendar or picture of one harvest festival and ask, “What crops are ready at this time?”
